name: panelforge
description: PanelForge — local-first desktop application for creating illustrated stories, comics, graphic novels, and webtoons (see Docs/PanelForge.pdf).

scripts.dev: tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/dev-check.js
scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.node.json --outDir out/node && tsc --project tsconfig.web.json --outDir out/web && node scripts/copy-renderer-html.js
